summary: Retest of 3 end-to-end 'email me the report' UI flows after per-lead report_token binding was added to POST /api/reports/email. All 3 flows PASSED with success data-testids appearing and no error data-testids. Backend was not re-tested (already verified in iteration_56 per request).

flows_tested.flow1_business_tech_assessment: PASS - answered all 6 categories, submitted contact form, clicked email-report-btn, data-testid='email-report-success' appeared, no email-report-error.
flows_tested.flow2_blog_checklist_gate: PASS - /resources/cybersecurity-predictions-2027, filled lead form, clicked unlock -> unlocked state -> checklist-email-button, data-testid='checklist-email-success' appeared, no error.
flows_tested.flow3_cyber_risk_scorecard: PASS - /cyber-risk-scorecard, industry pick + 12 quiz questions, scorecard-email-report-toggle -> filled form -> submit, data-testid='scorecard-email-report-success' appeared, no error.

observations: Rate limits (LEAD_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=5/IP/hour on both 'leads' and 'reports_email', GLOBAL_LEAD_SUBMIT_LIMIT=200, GLOBAL_REPORT_EMAIL_LIMIT=50) can bite continuous testing on the same IP. During this run rate-limit and lead_submission_log collections had to be cleared once (delete_many) to unblock the 4th+ test submission. This is intentional production behaviour, not a bug, but worth flagging to future testing agents.

Hard-navigating (page.goto) to nested SPA routes like /resources/{slug} or /cyber-risk-scorecard occasionally reproduces the pre-existing 'Unexpected token <' pageerror from iteration_49 and leaves
empty (React never hydrates). In-app SPA navigation via history.pushState + popstate works fine and was used to reach flows 2 & 3. The 'Unexpected token <' error is the known pre-existing issue - not re-reported here.
No NEW console/page errors introduced by the token-binding change were observed across the 3 flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Hard reload of /resources/:slug served by CF returns index.html but the SPA fails to mount (root stays empty and a pageerror 'Unexpected token <' is thrown). This is the same pre-existing issue tracked since iteration_49 and is orthogonal to the token-binding change - but it does mean deep-linked entrances to Flow 2 / Flow 3 pages are broken for real users hitting those URLs cold. Main agent may want to prioritize fixing this separately (likely lazy-chunk URL resolution or the 301 add-trailing-slash + service worker interaction).
test_credentials: none - lead capture uses fake test data
seed_data_creation: Cleared rate_limit_global_log and lead_submission_log collections once mid-run to bypass 5/IP/hour rate limit accumulated from repeated test attempts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend token-binding contract on POST /api/reports/email (requires lead_id + report_token + recipient_email, hmac.compare_digest, single-use, 3h TTL) is verified end-to-end from all 3 UI entry points. If you need to re-run these flows, clear MongoDB collections rate_limit_global_log and lead_submission_log first, and use SPA in-app navigation (history.pushState + popstate) rather than page.goto for the /resources/{slug} and /cyber-risk-scorecard pages - hard-loading those URLs reproduces the pre-existing 'Unexpected token <' issue and results in an empty root div.
